brief:
Netanyahu's Likud party sought to extend voting hours for Tuesday's election, but the opposing party of the prime minister's main challenger firmly opposes the measure, Middle East Eye reported. The challenger's party characterized the extension as an unfavorable procedural change.

The dispute reflects tension between the two camps ahead of the vote, with Netanyahu's bloc attempting to adjust electoral logistics while opposition forces resist what they view as a tactical maneuver.

title: Netanyahu challenger's party blocks voting extension bid
